newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti falls on results, share reduction.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti falls on results, share reduction.

text.p: Shares in information technology group Olivetti fell sharply on Wednesday after the group released its 1996 and first quarter 1997 results and outlined a share capital reduction operation, dealers said.
"The shares are weighed down by the necessity to reduce its share capital and the poor data on the first quarter of 1997," one share trader said in Milan.

The group said late Tuesday that it made a pretax loss of around 180 billion lire in the first quarter of 1997 and announced a complex share restructuring which will in effect reduce the number of shares in issue.
At 0855 GMT, Olivetti shares were off 9.12 percent at 504 lire close to the 10-percent level which triggers automatic share suspension on the Milan bourse.
